newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks slide in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks slide in dull trade.

text.p: Greek equities drifted 0.43 percent lower on flagging trading interest on Friday and brokers said apart from a few stocks which were suitable for short-term plays there was no news to stir the market.
"There are little news around to filter through to stocks around this time of the year and the market is fairly dull," said Evricos Sarsentis, broker at Telesis Securities.
"But a few specks of sharp movers, mostly large- and middle-caps with high profit growth offer excitement and profitable opportunities," he added.
Super market chain AB Vassilopoulos ended considerably lower on surprise news of sharply lower half-year profit, down 79 percent to 204 million drachmas.

"Following a spate of good news on upbeat interim profitability by banks and mid-caps which helped the index above 1,600 points, investors were dissapointed by news of impediments on OTE's investment programme and poor results by Vasilopoulos," said Sarsentis.
The Athens general index closed down 0.43 percent or 6.89 points at 1,591.45 from Thursday's 1,598.34 close with most sector subindices closing flat to lower.
Banks and industrials were respectively 0.47 and 0.44 percent lower.
Turnover was boosted to 13.6 billion drachmas on volume of 4.0 million shares by a series of blocks totalling 1.1 million shares of metallurgical firm Elval.

The shares were placed by block coordinator Telesis Securities along with Alpha Brokerage, National Securities and Hermes Securities with local and international institutional investors at 2,800 drachmas.
Decliners beat advancers 101 to 87 with 29 shares unchanged on 217 traded.
OTE telecom Global Depository Shares (GDS) were quoted on London's SEAQ International market at $10.60-$10.95. Two GDSs make up one share of OTE.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas, capped at 5,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,126-1,156 drachmas.

The recently launched second Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 6,800 drachmas, capped at 10,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,056-1,116 drachmas. The warrants expire December 16, 1998. Shares of the underlying stock closed unchanged at 6,300.
The Merrill Lynch American call warrant on a basket of 23 Greek equities that are part of the Athens general index was quoted at 634.53-675.03 drachmas. The warrants expire January 9 1998.

The ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $72.99-$75.77. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.

The ING Baring Financial Products American-style call warrant on a basket of six blue-chips denominated in drachmas was quoted at 3,438-3,659 drachmas. The strike price is set at 10,000 drachmas and the warrants expire on February 2, 1998.
The ING Baring American-style second call warrant on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $11.60 bid/no offer. The strike price is set at $110.0 and the warrants expire April 9 1998.

The recently launched ING Baring American-style, drachma- denominated call warrant on the bourse's benchmark index was quoted at 226-258 drachmas. The strike price is set at 1,639 points and the warrants expire May 14 1998.
